checks.name: Period recovery
checks.detail: no repeat of the transit in 327 days of TESS data (nothing of its depth above 7.0σ); most probable P ≈ 626 d (68%: 275-1300 d), from the periods the data allow and the transit probability; a second transit fixes it: the next TESS sectors of the star, or ground photometry

checks.detail: one transit: the period is unknown
checks.value: BTJD 2131.27 (sector 30, QLP): vetting SNR 11.1, 48.8 ppt (the search's SNR was 9.3: a different detrending, binning and noise estimate)

checks.name: Engineering data
checks.detail: no transit falls in a known engineering interval

checks.name: Raw flux (SAP)
checks.detail: the dip is in the raw aperture flux too, not made by the detrending

checks.name: Background correlation
checks.detail: the dip doesn't follow the pipeline's background estimate
checks.value: raw SAP 103 ppt ± 12.1; with the background regressed out 103 ppt ± 12.8; flux-background correlation |r| 0.14 within ±1.5 d

checks.name: Event consistency

checks.detail: a brightening at BTJD 4010.73 is also above the false-alarm threshold: the systematics make events this size in both directions
checks.value: the dip 21.0σ white, 11.0σ red (F_red 1.92 from 1232 box positions over 318 d); threshold 4.3σ (noise reaches it anywhere in that much data 1% of the time); strongest brightening 12.8σ red at BTJD 4010.73
